content: Chrome DevTools Protocol WebAuthn.addVirtualAuthenticator VirtualAuthenticatorOptions supports hasPrf: boolean (default false) to enable PRF extension support on the virtual authenticator, alongside hasResidentKey, hasUserVerification, hasLargeBlob, hasCredBlob, hasMinPinLength. Requires protocol chromium (ctap2), transport internal or usb etc. Usage: page.context().newCDPSession(page) -> session.send('WebAuthn.enable') -> session.send('WebAuthn.addVirtualAuthenticator', { options: { protocol: 'ctap2', transport: 'internal', hasResidentKey: true, hasUserVerification: true, hasPrf: true, isUserVerified: true } }). This is Chromium-only (via CDP) -- WebKit/Firefox virtual-authenticator support in Playwright is unreliable/unimplemented (WebKit issue open, no hasPrf equivalent confirmed), so automated PRF UAT should target Playwright's chromium channel specifically.
